description: TechEmpower-equivalent plaintext GET baseline. Minimum routing overhead. GET /plaintext returns 200 OK with body 'plaintext' (9 bytes).
loopback_caveat: Results are not equivalent to network-path benchmarks. transport_mode=loopback-h1 or loopback-h2 is mandatory in all result artifacts.

concurrency.note: Default: 4 threads, 100 connections. Override via WRK_CONNECTIONS / VUS env.

claim_scope_note: Promote to comparison_eligible after repeated runs on perf-box-amd64 with full reproducibility metadata.
